name: Shopify Competitor Price & Stock Change Alert (Sheets + Slack + Discord)

parameters.content:
## 01 · Shopify Competitor Price & Stock Monitor

Tracks public `/products.json` feeds on target Shopify stores on a polite 6-hour schedule, diffs variant prices & inventory availability against persistent workflow static state, and alerts Slack, Discord, and Google Sheets whenever a price drop or stock-out occurs.

### Required Environment Variables
- `SHOPIFY_COMPETITOR_STORES` (comma-separated domains, e.g. `allbirds.com,gymshark.com`)
- `PRICE_DROP_THRESHOLD_PCT` (default `5`)
- `GOOGLE_SHEET_ID` (target spreadsheet ID)
- `SLACK_ALERT_CHANNEL` (e.g. `#ecom-pricing-alerts`)
- `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL` (Discord channel webhook URL)

### Credentials to Connect
- Google Sheets OAuth2 (`REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_SHEETS_CREDENTIAL_ID`)
- Slack OAuth2 (`REPLACE_WITH_SLACK_CREDENTIAL_ID`)

## Diff Engine & Persistent State

`Compute Price & Stock Diffs` stores the last seen `{ price, available, title, handle }` map per `store::variantId` in `$getWorkflowStaticData('global')`.

- **First run**: Seeds baseline prices cleanly without spamming false alerts.
- **Subsequent runs**: Emits structured `PRICE_DROP`, `PRICE_INCREASE`, `OUT_OF_STOCK`, and `BACK_IN_STOCK` events with exact delta percentage and direct product URL.

## Alert Routing & Guardrails

Only executes Slack, Discord, and Google Sheets writes when `Has Price or Stock Changes?` evaluates `true`.

To stay polite and compliant:
- Poll no faster than every 4-6 hours.
- Respect `robots.txt` and keep `limit=250` single-page requests.
